text: The village of Bobrovy Yam (currently Bobrovskoye) was mentioned in the chronicles.
quote: The village of Bobrovy Yam ( currently Bobrovskoye ) was mentioned in the chronicles in 1425 .

subject: self
text: The area was included into Archangelgorod Governorate.
quote: In the course of the administrative reform carried out in 1708 by Peter the Great , the area was included into Archangelgorod Governorate .

subject: self
text: The governorate was abolished and transformed into Vologda Viceroyalty.
quote: In 1780 , the governorate was abolished and transformed into Vologda Viceroyalty .

subject: self
text: The viceroyalty was abolished and the part including Nyuksenitsa became Vologda Governorate.
quote: The latter was abolished in 1796 , and the part of it which included Nyuksenitsa became Vologda Governorate .

subject: self
text: The area was transferred to the newly established Northern Dvina Governorate.
quote: In 1918 , the area was transferred to the newly established Northern Dvina Governorate

subject: self
text: The uyezds were abolished in favor of the new divisions, the districts (raions).
quote: in 1924 the uyezds were abolished in favor of the new divisions , the districts ( raions ) .

subject: self
quote: Nyuksensky District was established on June 10 , 1924

subject: self
quote: On February 27 , 1928 , it was renamed Sukhonsky District .

subject: self
text: Northern Dvina Governorate was merged into Northern Krai.
quote: In 1929 , Northern Dvina Governorate was merged into Northern Krai

subject: other
quote: In 1929 , Northern Dvina Governorate was merged into Northern Krai , and Kokshengsky District was established .

subject: self
text: Sukhonsky and Kokshengsky Districts were merged, and Nyuksensky District was re-established.
quote: On July 30 , 1931 , Sukhonsky and Kokshengsky Districts were merged , and Nyuksensky District was re-established

subject: self
text: Tarnogsky District was split off from Nyuksensky District.
quote: In 1935 , Tarnogsky District was split off from Nyuksensky District .

subject: self
text: Northern Krai was transformed into Northern Oblast.
quote: In 1936 , Northern Krai was transformed into Northern Oblast

subject: self
text: Northern Oblast itself was split into Arkhangelsk Oblast and Vologda Oblast.
quote: in 1937 , Northern Oblast itself was split into Arkhangelsk Oblast and Vologda Oblast .
